narrative: Academic Office emails an urgent fee reconciliation alert.

message.body: Final Notice: Your tuition fee receipt is mismatched. Submit the updated verification form within 30 minutes to avoid course deregistration.

evidence.label: Official University Registrar Portal
evidence.value: Fee payment status marked Fully Paid on official portal.

consequence_text.safe: Checking your official student ledger confirmed your fees were already paid. You avoided opening an untrusted executable.
consequence_text.unsafe: Executing the script attachment would have compromised your student account credentials (simulated).

teaching_point: Threats of administrative penalties under tight deadlines are classic high-pressure cues.
